The '''central focus lens''' was a component of the [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] used on the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Stars]]. The lens was the focal point of the weapon, above which the eight [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] pulses generated by the [[amplification crystal]]s converged before firing.<ref name="EGWT" />
